scope: Primary sources supporting engineering-options.md. Proposed pilot and arithmetic scenarios are original analytical recommendations, not claims from these sources.

sources.title: Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works, 2073, Third Amendment 2082
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Department of Roads
sources.verified: PDF downloaded and text extracted locally; 787 pages. New concrete vehicle opening requires 28 days plus completed sealed joints/shoulders and Engineer approval; asphalt opening requires cooling to ambient and approval.
sources.caution: Do not replace Nepal new-construction requirements with FHWA rapid-repair opening examples. Contract-specific amendments must also be checked.

sources.title: Guidelines for the Design of Flexible Pavements, Second Edition 2021
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Department of Roads
sources.verified: 85-page official PDF read. Explicitly withdraws first 2014 edition; provides multi-factor selection, layered design, rutting/fatigue considerations and distinct low-volume methods.

sources.title: Pavement Design Guidelines (Rigid Pavement)
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Department of Roads
locators: pp19-21 slab stress conditions and load transfer
sources.verified: Official PDF downloaded and title verified as 2021. Major-highway DLC minimum recommendation 150 mm; flexural-strength pavement design and direct beam testing for major projects; traffic/temperature/support affect slab design.
sources.caution: The URL was intermittently slow in browser retrieval; local PDF extraction succeeded. Do not use 2016 mirror copies as the current 2021 text.

sources.title: Geotechnical Aspects of Pavements, Chapter 7
sources.verified: Explains moisture entry and drainage effects on pavement materials and distresses.
sources.caution: Mechanisms are transferable; design thresholds and site outcomes require Nepal data.

sources.title: Protecting Slopes to Build Resilient Roads in Nepal
sources.verified: Describes DoR-implemented Narayanghat-Mugling slope work using drainage, bioengineering and specialist stabilisation. Supports treating corridor geohazards separately from paving choice.
sources.caution: Project narrative, not a controlled comparison of asphalt and concrete.

sources.title: Improving Transportation Investment Decisions Through Life-Cycle Cost Analysis
sources.verified: Explains comparable alternatives, activity schedules, agency/user cost and discounting.

sources.title: Life-Cycle Cost Analysis Primer
locators: pp12-16 agency/user costs and residual service life
sources.verified: Covers constant-price costs, user impacts and remaining service life at analysis end. It is a method source, not evidence for Nepal costs or lifetimes.

sources.title: Warm Mix Asphalt FAQs
sources.verified: Documents warm-mix technology and lower-temperature production; used only to identify a trial variant, without adopting foreign savings percentages.

sources.title: Asphalt Pavement Recycling with Reclaimed Asphalt Pavement
sources.verified: Recycling must remain cost-effective, environmentally responsible and meet performance requirements; appropriate materials evaluation and mix verification are necessary.
